judgements.justification: In A, Reviewer_ecPK added the subsampling/mechanism-specificity objection and cut 6 to 5 on 2021-09-06, a month after the response, with no author reply; B's main objection (eGa2) was raised in time and refuted.
The gap comes from which reviewers were drawn (weak 5s in A, a thin but favourable 8 in B), not from B scoring equally favourable verbal assessments higher.

A's ecPK judged the result valid only for one synthesis technique and A's AC repeated the doubt and asked for discussion of mechanism assumptions while keeping a poster, whereas B's AC took the claim as applying to any private algorithm.
A's reviewers did not converge on marginal accept at low confidence: scores were split 5/5/6/7 at confidences 3 to 4, and ecPK checked the proof.
